title: Query keys and caching
expectedPositive: Switch between todo and done. Inspect Query Devtools and verify different keys; no cross-filter content leakage. Cancel a request by switching rapidly.
expectedNegative: The starter uses a constant cache key for different status-filtered responses.
securityBoundary: Never include access tokens or raw private task titles in a query key; tenant scope belongs in a secure key namespace and server authorization.
